restrictions: C39 PB=0 ordinary-collision construction for sha256-r39-prefix-v1 only. Every trial uses a fresh random 64-byte first block and one random A0; every candidate is verified by two complete second-block compressions before output.

The online run contains exactly N=1173433569311756739413236012 trial slots and a global cap of 8*64*N target-compression units. Reaching the cap returns failure. Preprocessing adds at most 2^74 target-compression units.

The probability claim is exploratory and conditional on H1 matching-class transfer to uniform real chaining values, H2 fresh-trial success amplification including correlated siblings, H3 construction of the remaining core/j/group parameters, and the measured rate/cost transfer stated below.

Memory is a complete 19 GiB peak. It includes the 17 GiB + 4 B inverse table, 1 GiB construction positions, and the remaining 1 GiB - 4 B for code, parameters, allocator, stack, messages, counters, lookup buffers, and retained randomness.

heuristics.statement: For each fresh random first block, H=F39(IV,M0) behaves as an independent uniform chaining value for the C39 matching class and the modular tail event. Thus the reconstructed-class mean tail probability applies to a real first block.
heuristics.scope: The fixed C39 core, j=adc6d187, q-aware list 3630571a..., PB=0 table, and sha256-r39-prefix-v1.
heuristics.extrapolation: Fresh q and modular-tail campaigns sample the exact matching-class output population of the frozen deterministic list. H1 transfers their conditional mean to the one real H of a fresh first-block trial.
heuristics.limitations: The approximately 2^-75 tail event cannot be observed directly on real chaining values. The list was frozen before fresh q/tail holdout, but fixed reproducibility seeds are not ideal coins and matching-class checks do not prove the real-chain transfer.

heuristics.statement: A fresh-first-block trial succeeds with probability at least p0=2^-90.38540845807911, including any dependence among sibling outputs, and distinct fresh trials amplify as independent Bernoulli trials.
heuristics.scope: The N fresh-first-block trials and fixed global work cap in proof Section 8.
heuristics.extrapolation: The exact 1/64 and M factors times separate q Hoeffding and tail Student 99.9% endpoints supply p0. N makes untruncated success at least 0.516. The Markov/union-bound wrapper subtracts at most 1/8 and leaves at least 0.391.
heuristics.limitations: Linearity proves expected successful outputs, not probability of at least one. H2 is the explicit sibling conversion. Hoeffding assumes ideal iid prefix coins; Student-t tail coverage is model-dependent; together the marginal models imply a 99.8% simultaneous nominal guarantee. The A2-free bound is not used.

heuristics.statement: The documented C39 preprocessing constructs the core, j=adc6d187, 50 group labels, and the exact q-aware list within 2^74 target-compression units and the 19 GiB peak.
heuristics.scope: One-time construction of the C39 core, j/group labels, and list SHA-256 3630571a... used by this candidate.
heuristics.extrapolation: The list construction is deterministic and replays byte-identically after 126,025,728 prefix checks; a complete exact q-aware route is bounded below 2^68 units. The 2^74 total also covers the declared 34-free-bit core search and published j/group parameter search.
heuristics.limitations: The submitted list no longer depends on the missing historical list transcript. The release still omits the original search transcript for the core, j and 50 group labels; their discovery bound remains the score-critical part of H3. The full exact q-aware enumeration was specified but not physically completed.

heuristics.statement: The true expected charged work of one fresh-first-block C39 trial is at most 64 target-compression units, and the measured branch frequencies transfer to the full run.
heuristics.scope: The exact algorithm in proof Section 4 under collision-frontier-v5 with C39=2812 and each random table lookup charged as one full compression.
heuristics.extrapolation: A conservative itemized ledger with every bucket scan charged at the 224-entry maximum gives 9.031045 units and the declaration raises it to 64. The prior 2^34-trial counters support branch envelopes; the one-entry list change and fresh q holdout are covered by the rounded bounds.
heuristics.limitations: The experiment runs self-contained formulas and checks endpoint and cost-row-sum arithmetic, not a full native 17 GiB implementation or every primary counter. The 7.087x slack covers the declared primitive census, but H4 remains a score-critical cost/rate premise.
